prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Baytown, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1190; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident details, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?
A: I was driving through an intersection in Baytown, Texas, heading east. The light had been green for me.
Q: What was the traffic like at that time?
A: Pretty light. It was mid-morning, so not many cars around.
Q: Which direction was the other vehicle traveling?
A: It came toward me from the opposite direction. It was in my lane when it hit me, or at least it crossed over into my lane.
Q: How fast were you going?
A: Not fast at all. I was maybe twenty miles an hour, trying to be careful at the intersection.
Q: Did you brake or swerve before impact?
A: I tried to brake and turned a little to the right, but there wasn't much room.
Q: How would you describe the impact?
A: It wasn't a hard crash, more of a bump, but I felt something in my shoulder right away.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle or speak with the other driver?
A: I got out for a minute. The other driver seemed fine and we exchanged information.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same afternoon. My right shoulder has been sore and I have limited range of motion when I lift my arm.
Q: Have you had any prior problems with that shoulder?
A: Not that I can recall. I'm not a doctor, so I can't say for sure.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm still dealing with the pain, and I'd like to be kept updated on the claim.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
